payload.description: Salted commitment to the Delta's content (DC-1 §3.6). The content itself travels as a Payload alongside the Block (DC-3 §6.1) and never enters the Log.

bytes.description: Octets of JCS(content) = extract_cap_bytes + summary_cap_bytes + the 23 octets of {"extract":,"summary":} structure that surround them (DC-1 §3.6). It is a derived bound, not an independent constant.

lang.description: A BCP 47 language tag: a 2- or 3-letter primary subtag followed by any number of subtags of 1-8 alphanumerics. The earlier two-letter, one-subtag shape rejected conforming tags such as `yue`, `zh-Hant-HK` and `pt-BR-x-private`.

allOf.comment: DC-1 §3.3: `new` and `update` are the content-bearing change types. One that commits to nothing claims content without saying what it is, and no audit could ever check it (DC-4 §5) — DC1-E09.
DC-1 §3.3: `attest` and `delete` carry no content of their own; what they are measured against is the Reference Payload (DC-4 §5).

DC-1 §3.3: `update`, `delete` and `attest` each say something about a URL's earlier state, so each MUST name the Delta it follows. Only `new` may omit `prev`, and only when it is the very first Delta for that URL — a condition no schema can see, which is why `new` is absent from this branch and DC1-E07 is where it is enforced.
